{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Otheruses|Shield}}
A '''particle shield''', '''navigational shield''',<ref name="FTS">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref> or '''concussion shield'''<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] used to absorb the kinetic energy of physical projectiles, such as [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], or space debris. Particle shields were ineffective against [[Laser/Legends|laser]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire, and offered no protection from them.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>  

Particle shields strengthened the molecular bonds of [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plating using energy charges, giving [[Starship/Legends|starships]] enhanced hull integrity. The shields were constantly powered to deal with small particles impacting the ship, such as [[Meteorite/Legends|micrometeors]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The shield had to be deactivated to launch spacecraft such as [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] or [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], or if a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] wished to fire its own projectiles.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Microsecond/Legends|Microsecond]] precision was required during combat to reduce the time that the ship was vulnerable with its shields down; [[Computer/Legends|computers]] were used to lower and raise the shields with the precision needed.<ref name="EGWT" />

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], during a [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]], though the particle shield of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] borrowed [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] held up in the explosive aftermath of the destruction of [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit]] ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[Transport/Legends|transport]], Skywalker was forced to finish the job when he noticed that the derelict's 20-warhead sensor-[[Guided missile/Legends|guided missile]] silo was still intact and on a trajectory towards [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor's]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]]. Aiming the CloakShape's [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion-missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launcher]] at the silo, Skywalker was successful in destroying it, but the powerful blast's shock waves sent his [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] into an out-of-control spiral, down through Nallastia's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to the moon's surface, where it crash-landed. Skywalker was later retrieved by his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>
